episode.title: This GIANT OWL Is NOT Real

synopsis: On a dimly lit jungle set, a huge owl silently swoops to engulf a performer, only for its beak to be gently pried open by crew hands, freeing him.

shots.prompt:
SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators with their rigs in the foreground. One giant creature faces exactly one man, who stands his ground and watches its jaws begin to part.

SHOT 1, THE THREAT ON SET. A built film set reads immediately: dressed practical set pieces and haze around the frame, a green screen wall visible beyond them, and the backs of camera operators in the foreground. One massive, mottled brown and white owl, with soft, downy feathers, huge, piercing yellow eyes, and a sharp, hooked beak, its head alone reaching over five metres high, faces Ihsan, who stands his ground on the jungle floor and watches its beak begin to part. Ambient sound only: rustling leaves, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The creature's jaws open wide and close over exactly one man until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with the man nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming.

SHOT 2, TAKEN INSIDE. The massive, mottled brown and white owl, with soft, downy feathers, huge, piercing yellow eyes, and a sharp, hooked beak, its head alone reaching over five metres high, opens its beak wide and closes over Ihsan until he is completely out of sight inside its mouth, and the creature settles with Ihsan nowhere in frame. The crew keep filming. Ambient sound only: rustling leaves, studio air handling and distant crew movement.

SHOT 3, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. Crew members put their hands on the creature and push its jaws open, and the same one man climbs out of the mouth onto the set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal.

SHOT 3, THE PRACTICAL REVEAL. Crew members put their hands on the massive owl's beak and gently pry it open, revealing the lightweight armature and foam interior, and Ihsan climbs out of the mouth onto the jungle set floor unharmed, showing that the creature is a built practical prop rather than a living animal. Ambient sound only: rustling leaves, studio air handling and distant crew movement.
